# Investigating Value of Information in Future Vehicular Communications
Marco Giordani, Andrea Zanella, Takamasa Higuchi, Onur Altintas, Michele Zorzi · 2019 IEEE 2nd Connected and Automated Vehicles Symposium (CAVS) 2019 · https://doi.org/10.1109/cavs.2019.8887791 · relevance: low · basis: abstract

**Problem:** The next generations of vehicles are expected to be equipped with sophisticated sensors to support advanced automotive services.
**Approach:** The large volume of data generated by such applications will likely put a strain on the vehicular communication technologies, which may be unable to guarantee the required quality of service. In this scenario, it is fundamental to assess the value of information (VoI) provided by each data source, to prioritize the transmissions that have greatest importance for the target applications.
**Tools and scale:** Mentioned in abstract: simulation.
**Results:** No quantitative results stated in the abstract.
**Limitations and future work (as stated by the authors):**
- None stated in the abstract.
**Overlap with our engine:** partial — touches vehicular networking, network/traffic simulation but not the joint traffic/radio/SCMS closed loop.
**Novelty implications:** Nothing in our candidate directions is ruled out; useful only as background on vehicular networking.
